arxiv-2107-12265.title: Co-Optimization of Design and Fabrication Plans for Carpentry Journal: TOG CCS: Computing methodologies Shape modeling CCS: Computing methodologies Graphics systems and interfaces
arxiv-2107-12265.creator: Haisen Zhao, Max Willsey, Amy Zhu, Chandrakana Nandi, Zachary Tatlock, Justin Solomon, Adriana Schulz
arxiv-2107-12265.description: Abstract . Past work on optimizing fabrication plans given a carpentry design can provide Pareto-optimal plans trading off between material waste, fabrication time, precision, and other considerations. However, when developing fabrication plans, experts rarely restrict to a single design , instead considering families of design variations , sometimes adjusting designs to simplify fabrication.

arxiv-2307-13691.title: A Comprehensive Review of Recent Research Trends on UAVs
arxiv-2307-13691.creator: Kaled Telli 1 , Okba Kraa 1 , Yassine Himeur 2 , Abdelmalik Ouamane 3 , Mohamed Boumehraz 1 , Shadi Atalla 2 and Wathiq Mansoor 2
arxiv-2307-13691.description: Abstract The growing interest in unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) from both scientific and industrial sectors has attracted a wave of new researchers and substantial investments in this expansive field. However, due to the wide range of topics and subdomains within UAV research, newcomers may find themselves overwhelmed by the numerous options available.

arxiv-2405-01420.title: GROMACS on AMD GPU-Based HPC Platforms: Using SYCL for Performance and Portability Thanks: This work was supported by the Intel Corporation via Intel oneAPI Academic Center of Excellence at KTH, the Swedish Foundation for Strategic Research, the Swedish e-Science Research Center, the National Academ
arxiv-2405-01420.creator: Andrey Alekseenko, Szilárd Páll, Erik Lindahl
arxiv-2405-01420.description: Abstract GROMACS is a widely-used molecular dynamics software package with a focus on performance, portability, and maintainability across a broad range of platforms. Thanks to its early algorithmic redesign and flexible heterogeneous parallelization, GROMACS has successfully harnessed GPU accelerators for more than a decade.

arxiv-2409-05077.title: Wheeler-DeWitt equation and the late gravitational collapse: effects of factor ordering and the tunneling scenario
arxiv-2409-05077.creator: Davide Batic, M. Nowakowski, N. G. Kelkar
arxiv-2409-05077.description: Abstract We set up the Wheeler-DeWitt (WDW) equation for late gravitational collapse. The fact that the gravitational collapse and the expanding/ collapsing universe can be described within the realm of the Robertson-Walker metric renders the corresponding WDW equation for collapsing matter a timeless Schrödinger equation.

arxiv-2502-13616.title: Bound states of quasiparticles with quartic dispersion in an external potential: WKB approach
arxiv-2502-13616.creator: E.V. Gorbar, V.P. Gusynin
arxiv-2502-13616.description: Abstract The Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin semiclassical method is formulated for quasiparticles with quartic-in-momentum dispersion which presents the simplest case of a soft energy-momentum dispersion. It is shown that matching wave functions in the classically forbidden and allowed regions requires the consideration of higher-order Airy-type functions.

arxiv-2601-09000.title: Universal Dynamics of Warmup Stable Decay: understanding WSD beyond Transformers
arxiv-2601-09000.creator: Annalisa Belloni, Lorenzo Noci, Antonio Orvieto
arxiv-2601-09000.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Annalisa Belloni, Lorenzo Noci, Antonio Orvieto. The Warmup Stable Decay (WSD) learning rate scheduler has recently become popular, largely due to its good performance and flexibility when training large language models. It remains an open question whether the remarkable performance of WSD – using a decaying learning rate for only a fraction of training compared to cosine decay – is a phenomenon specific to transformer-based language models that can potentially offer new theoretical insights into their training dynamics.

pmc-10652535.title: Living with polypharmacy: a narrative interview study with older Pakistanis in East London
pmc-10652535.creator: Najia Sultan, Deborah Swinglehurst
pmc-10652535.description: BackgroundPolypharmacy is a growing and major public health issue. It can be burdensome and risky for patients and costly to healthcare systems. Older adults and those from ethnic minority backgrounds are disproportionately affected by polypharmacy. This study focuses on medication practices among Urdu-speaking Pakistani patients, a significant ethnic group in the UK.

pmc-11357084.title: Synthesis of Highly Porous Lignin-Sulfonate Sulfur-Doped Carbon for Efficient Adsorption of Sodium Diclofenac and Synthetic Effluents
pmc-11357084.creator: Glaydson S. dos Reis, Sarah Conrad, Eder C. Lima, Mu. Naushad, Gopinathan Manavalan, Francesco G. Gentili, Guilherme Luiz Dotto, Alejandro Grimm
pmc-11357084.description: Herein, a novel sulfur-doped carbon material has been synthesized via a facile and sustainable single-step pyrolysis method using lignin-sulfonate (LS), a by-product of the sulfite pulping process, as a novel carbon precursor and zinc chloride as a chemical activator. The sulfur doping process had a remarkable impact on the LS-sulfur carbon structure.

pmc-11386312.title: PB1-F2 of low pathogenicity H7N7 restricts apoptosis in avian cells
pmc-11386312.creator: Luise Hohensee, David Scheibner, Christine Luttermann, Holly Shelton, Anca Dorhoi, Elsayed M. Abdelwhab, Ulrike Blohm
pmc-11386312.description: Highlights•In chicken full-length PB1-F2 of LPAIV H7N7 prolonged survival of infected cells by limiting apoptotic cell death.•PB1-F2 knockout LPAIV significantly decreased MHC-I expression on fibroblasts, delayed tissue healing and increased phagocytic uptake of infected cells.•Taken together, the full-length PB1-F2 allows AIV to cause prolonged infections without serious harm to the avian host.

pmc-12563330.title: Fractal Neural Dynamics and Memory Encoding Through Scale Relativity
pmc-12563330.creator: Călin Gheorghe Buzea, Valentin Nedeff, Florin Nedeff, Mirela Panaite Lehăduș, Lăcrămioara Ochiuz, Dragoș Ioan Rusu, Maricel Agop, Dragoș Teodor Iancu
pmc-12563330.description: Background/Objectives: Synaptic plasticity is fundamental to learning and memory, yet classical models such as Hebbian learning and spike-timing-dependent plasticity often overlook the distributed and wave-like nature of neural activity. We present a computational framework grounded in Scale Relativity Theory (SRT), which describes neural propagation along fractal geodesics in a non-differentiable space-time.

pmc-12682037.title: Shorter versus longer-duration antibiotic treatments for immunocompetent patients with bloodstream infections: a Bayesian perspective
pmc-12682037.creator: Ruslan Akhmedullin, Abduzhappar Gaipov
pmc-12682037.description: s be improved to strengthen their implications. The authors claimed that “There are probably little or no differences” in mortality (RR 0.91, 95% CI 0.79–1.05) and relapses (RR 1.14, 95% CI 0.80–1.62) when comparing the treatment regimens. Any scientific statement should include a probability that expresses confidence in the effect.

pmc-12745361.title: Dysadherin/YAP axis fuels stem plasticity and immune escape in liver cancer
pmc-12745361.creator: Tae-Young Jang, So-El Jeon, Hyeon-Ji Yun, Choong-Jae Lee, Da-Ye Lim, Sang Hoon Lee, Dajun Lee, Seungwon Lee, Jungmin Choi, Hyung-Sik Kim, Jeong-Seok Nam
pmc-12745361.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is an aggressive malignancy that is often refractory to chemotherapy and immune checkpoint inhibitors. This therapeutic resistance is driven in part by the persistence of cancer stem-like cells (CSCs) and the development of an immune-cold tumor microenvironment. However, the upstream regulators that coordinate these malignant features remain poorly defined.

pmc-12752181.title: Mood states recognition based on Mandarin speech and deep learning in patients with bipolar disorder
pmc-12752181.creator: Jinhao Li, Qiuping Yan, Minghui Li, Xiaofei Hou, Chao Li, Ziping Zhao, Huifang Yin, Guangming Xu
pmc-12752181.description: BackgroundCurrent assessments of bipolar disorder mainly rely on clinician’s experience and patients’ self-reporting, which has the risk of observer bias and subjective cognitive bias. There is an urgent need for more objective indicators to improve the accuracy of recognizing and monitoring mood states in patients with bipolar disorder.

pmc-13187614.title: FPECGNET: A deep learning framework based on federated learning and prototype learning for interpretable ECG classification with privacy
pmc-13187614.creator: Jiang He, Jie He, Jin Xiong, Song He, Yu Chen, XinWei Li
pmc-13187614.description: SummaryUnder everyday operational conditions, data privacy regulations prohibit sharing information between hospitals or institutions, contributing to the emergence of data silos. This scarcity of data hinders improvements in model performance. Another major obstacle to AI applications in medicine is the lack of interpretability, where the decision-making process of models cannot be reflected.

pmc-13332313.title: Trofinetide Use and Treatment Patterns Among Children Aged 2–4 Years with Rett Syndrome in the United States: A Retrospective Specialty Pharmacy Linked Claims Database Analysis
pmc-13332313.creator: Nazia Rashid, Vinod Kumar Yakkala, Dilesh Doshi, Krithika Rajagopalan
pmc-13332313.description: IntroductionRett syndrome (RTT) is a rare, X-linked neurodevelopmental disorder that primarily affects females. Trofinetide (TROF) was approved for RTT in individuals aged ≥2 years. Although the DAFFODIL trial examined TROF efficacy in children aged 2–4 years, real-world evidence in this age group remains limited.MethodsA retrospective cohort study was conducted using linked medical and pharmacy claims from 01/01/2021-09/30/2024 (study period).

pmc-13477108.title: The influence of a longitudinal virtual research mentorship program on medical students’ research skills
pmc-13477108.creator: Gianna Dafflisio, Nina Uzoigwe, John A. Treffalls, Samantha Xu, Benjamin L. Shou, Lena E. Trager, Sharon Ben-Or, Tyler Wallen, Roman V. Petrov, Charles Bakhos, Sai Yendamuri, Doraid Jarrar
pmc-13477108.description: ObjectiveResearch experience is critical for medical students pursuing cardiothoracic surgery, yet many lack access to mentorship and research opportunities. To address this gap, the Eastern Cardiothoracic Surgical Society launched a virtual, longitudinal research mentorship program for students at institutions with limited cardiothoracic surgery opportunities.
